notes.title: Version and Publisher Changes
notes.notes:
Hey there folks,

During the last year or so Ground Control Studios was the "caretaker" of Hush on Steam, since there were plans for us to do a complete refactor of the game and fix its many issues.

That plan was due to kick-off after we finalize our work on other on-going games (Hyper Gods and two more).

However, Hush's owner and initial developer, GameStudio78 has different plans to the IP and requested that the game was returned to them. We were happy to oblige and so Hush is changing hands.

That change however will imply that the current version of the game is rolled back to a earlier demo. You will find that the gameplay is a bit different, some of you will provably like that version better, others won't, on either case it doesn't feature any save-games, Steam integrations and the level is different. 

So, 5 days from now (on Friday) we will upload the rollback and trigger an update to everyone. If you want to keep the current version, please disable "automatic updates" for the game on the library. If you want to try the "alternative" version, no action is required. Keep in mind that after the update there is no way to reverse to the current version.

And that's it folks, we are sorry to see this one go, but maybe it is for the best. We wish GS78 the best of luck on bringing this game back and we hope it does get ressurected and that you guys get the game you were hoping for!

Team Ground Control signing off!

notes.title: HUSH – Into the Darkness new Publisher and Gameplay
notes.notes:
HUSH – Into the Darkness will now be published by our partners at Ground Control Sutdios. 

They will also be ensuring the game’s technical development. Game Studio 78 has made this decision following the feedback we obtained from those who played it, and because, right now, the game doesn’t have the quality that we ambition and that you, the players, deserve. 

As such we’ll keep on working towards giving HUSH the quality it always deserved to enjoy. 

A major update is being worked on, where the gameplay will be adhering to a new kind of design while maintaining the same visual presentation and story.

Thank you all for being a community who, through all of your comments and reviews, shares our interest in the potential that the adventures of Ashlyn and GoGo still hold, and for that we’re truly thankful.

Thank you so much for playing and for supporting Game Studio 78; without you none of this would be possible.

GS78 Team

notes.title: Camera and Combat System Improvements - HUSH 1.0.4
Camera and Combat System Improvements - HUSH 1.0.4
Combat Improvements / Supported Controllers - HUSH 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey There,

Here is our latest update Hush 1.0.3:

Now, we'd like to let you know that HUSH has these supported controller types:

. XBox 360
. XBox One
. PS3
. PS4
. Logitech F310 and F710
. MadCatz CTLR

Some model variations may work as well, so if you're having problems with any of these please send us an email to: support@gamestudio78.pt

Other improvements:

- Combat System
- New Layout Keyboard
- Minor bug fixes

Info: Please delete any previous save game of Hush.


Thank you for your support.

GS78
